title: Bright Top Floor 1BR-1BA Noe Valley Condominium
body:
Bright and beautifully finished, this handsome top floor 1910 Edwardian condominium is situated on a tree-lined block near Noe Valley's beloved Sanchez "Slow Street". Natural light accentuates the pristine oak floors of this full floor flat, which blend flawlessly with classic detailing and modern conveniences. The open living and kitchen area is anchored by a big granite counter, perfect for gatherings and informal dining.

title: Remodeled Apartment with High Ceilings in Noe/Mission
body:
Open Showing: Friday, June 19, from 5:15 to 6:00 pm. Please contact agent with any questions or to schedule a showing for a later day. Thank you!

For Rent: 3769 Cesar Chavez St. Apt. C San Francisco, CA 94110

Awesome location with numerous transportation, shopping, and dining options. Walking distance to BART and minutes from freeway access.

Large 1 bedroom unit with very high, 10+ foot, ceilings in the living room. Remodeled kitchen features stone countertops and stainless steel finish appliances including a dishwasher, gas range, refrigerator, and hood.

Coin-operated washer and dryer in building. Cozy shared backyard/patio.

- $4000 /mo. rent - $4000 security deposit
- 1 year lease - tenant pays, PG&E and garbage
- pet cat or small dog is ok
